baseline.behavior: Proof-carrying context, temporal claims, objective state, outcome policy, and Skill Foundry were durable on one ContextLattice instance but had no signed portable artifact or encrypted recipient-scoped exchange format.

holdouts: identity files remain owner-only and public metadata contains no private key material
Passport digest, signature, identity, validity window, and parent linkage fail closed on tamper
secret-bearing keys, token-like literals, and machine-local roots are removed before signing
identical imports are idempotent and divergent same-revision imports remain conflict branches
conflict-free Passport batches become visible atomically and incomplete transaction groups are ignored on reload
failed compaction preserves the complete in-memory Passport state
Mesh grants are signed, project-scoped, capability-bound, expiring, and locally revocable
inner and outer Mesh signatures bind ciphertext, sender, grant, recipient, project, expiry, and Passport digest
wrong-recipient, ciphertext-tamper, project-mismatch, expiry, and revocation paths fail closed
Mesh import defaults to dry-run and mutates the Passport ledger only after explicit apply
replay returns validated inputs without executing imported content or mutating ordinary memory
all Passport and Mesh HTTP success envelopes report contract_valid=true
CLI artifact output is owner-only, atomically replaced, and bounded on read
ContextLattice performs no envelope transport or delivery network call

cost.passport_store: bounded append-only NDJSON with complete-batch recovery and newest-record compaction
cost.mesh_store: bounded atomic JSON containing public grants, local revocation tombstones, and compact receipts
cost.identity: one local owner-only Ed25519 and age X25519 key file

failures.failure: nested Go structs serialized correctly but were rejected before serialization by the boundary validator
failures.resolution: normalize typed values to their exact JSON wire representation once before validation and added real HTTP contract tests

failures.failure: existing cognition ledger environment variables were documented but not mapped into the gateway container, leaving state in the replaceable container layer
failures.resolution: mapped claim, policy, Skill Foundry, Passport, identity, and Mesh stores into the existing durable data volume and added compose assertions

failures.failure: Passport compaction pruned in-memory records before the replacement ledger rename succeeded
failures.resolution: defer in-memory pruning until after successful atomic replacement and force filesystem failure in regression coverage

failures.failure: an unavailable backend context pack could leave preflight context_pack null under concurrent test pressure
failures.resolution: preserve a typed degraded unavailable envelope so preflight remains contract-valid without fabricating evidence
